sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: Way back in the 3rd century AD,
a monk in the Egyptian desert warned of evil spirits people should try to overcome.
sentences.zh: 一位埃及沙漠中的僧侣就曾告诫人们要克服心中的邪念。

sentences.en: In Christianity, these became known as the seven deadly sins.
sentences.zh: 在基督教中，这些邪念被称为“七宗罪”。

sentences.en: Pride, gluttony, greed, lust, sloth, wrath, and one more.
sentences.zh: 傲慢、暴食、贪婪、色欲、懒惰、愤怒，还有最后一条。

sentences.en: It's an ugly, miserable, unflattering emotion.
sentences.zh: 这是一种丑陋、痛苦且令人难堪的情绪。

sentences.en: Everyone, at some time or another, will experience this feeling
sentences.zh: 每个人在某个时刻，都会产生这种感觉：

sentences.en: of wanting what someone else has and resenting them for having it.
sentences.zh: 渴望拥有别人所拥有的东西，并因别人拥有它而心生怨恨。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Jessica Kyle from Atlanta, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫杰西卡·凯尔，来自佐治亚州亚特兰大。

sentences.en: In 2014, Jessica and her best friend traveled to the remote Comoros Islands in the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 2014年，杰西卡和她最好的朋友前往印度洋上偏远的科摩罗群岛。

sentences.en: They were there to teach English.
It was meant to be a grand adventure and could have been a high point in their friendship.
sentences.zh: 这本该是一场伟大的冒险，也本该成为她们友谊的高光时刻。

sentences.en: Except Jessica and her friend got sick, really sick, with dengue fever.
sentences.zh: 但杰西卡和她的朋友病倒了，病得很重，患上了登革热。

sentences.en: I was single and she was married to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 当时我单身，而她嫁给了一位医生。

sentences.en: And her husband was really worried about her and was able to get her evacuated to Kenya.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫非常担心她，并成功将她撤离到了肯尼亚。

sentences.en: To Nairobi, to be exact, to a hospital with air conditioning, good food, and excellent medical care.
sentences.zh: 准确地说是内罗毕，住进了一家有空调、食物充足且医疗条件优越的医院。

sentences.en: Jessica, meanwhile, was stuck on the island.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，杰西卡却被困在岛上。

sentences.en: Where it was about 100 degrees and we had no electricity and I was very hot and didn't have any good food.
sentences.zh: 那里气温高达100华氏度（约38摄氏度），没有电，我感到非常燥热，也没有任何像样的食物。

sentences.en: Jessica couldn't stop thinking about how her friend was getting much better care than she was.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡无法停止去想，她的朋友得到的照顾远比她好。

sentences.en: Now, besides being sick, Jessica felt she was suffering from a new malaise.
sentences.zh: 现在，除了生病之外，杰西卡还感到自己陷入了一种新的痛苦之中。

sentences.en: I was really, really envious of her to the point where it was actually physically painful,
sentences.zh: 我当时真的、真的非常嫉妒她，甚至到了身体上感到痛苦的地步，

sentences.en: other than just having dengue fever, that envy I felt because I wanted to be in her place.
sentences.zh: 除了登革热带来的病痛，那种嫉妒感让我备受煎熬，因为我渴望能处在她的位置上。

sentences.en: Indeed, that is the purpose of envy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这正是嫉妒的目的所在。

sentences.en: It's a tool for social comparison.
sentences.zh: 它是一种社会比较的工具。

sentences.en: It cues you in to your relative position among friends, colleagues, and peers.
sentences.zh: 它能让你意识到自己在朋友、同事和同龄人中的相对位置。

sentences.en: In Jessica's case, she was clearly in a weaker position than her friend.
sentences.zh: 在杰西卡的案例中，她显然处于比朋友更弱势的地位。

sentences.en: The envy was sounding the alarm.
Jessica did eventually recover, as did her friend.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡最终康复了，她的朋友也是。

sentences.en: And when they were reunited, Jessica told her friend about the pain of being abandoned.
sentences.zh: 当她们重逢时，杰西卡向朋友倾诉了被抛弃的痛苦。

sentences.en: And it took several conversations with her when she got back on the island explaining how much I was hurt by that,
sentences.zh: 回到岛上后，我与她进行了好几次谈话，解释了这件事对我造成的伤害，

sentences.en: knowing it wasn't her fault, but still needing to get those feelings out there.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不是她的错，但我仍需要把这些感受表达出来。

sentences.en: She's still one of my best friends and I did get over it eventually, but it was really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 她依然是我最好的朋友之一，我最终也走出了阴影，但这真的、真的非常艰难。

sentences.en: Of course, not all stories of envy end with growth and understanding.
sentences.zh: 当然，并非所有关于嫉妒的故事都能以成长和理解告终。

sentences.en: Very often, envy leads to wicked places and tragic consequences.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，嫉妒会引向邪恶的深渊和悲剧性的后果。

sentences.en: People started sending me a link to a story about people in the Gaza Strip or people in Israel
sentences.zh: 人们开始给我发送一个故事链接，讲述加沙地带或以色列的人们，

sentences.en: who were sitting on their couches watching bombs get lobbed at the other side and cheering.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在沙发上，看着炸弹投向对方阵营，并为此欢呼雀跃。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we bring you a favorite episode from 2018 that delves deeply into an emotion most of us prefer to hide.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们为您带来2018年的一期精选节目，深入探讨一种我们大多数人宁愿隐藏的情绪。

sentences.en: It's an emotion that can have a positive side, prompting us to take steps to improve our lives.
sentences.zh: 这是一种可能具有积极面、促使我们采取行动改善生活的情绪。

sentences.en: But envy can often turn malicious, prompting us to resentment, rage, even revenge.
sentences.zh: 但嫉妒往往会变得恶毒，诱发怨恨、愤怒，甚至报复。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine life without the pleasure of happiness or the pain of deep sadness.
sentences.zh: 很难想象没有快乐的愉悦或深切悲伤的痛苦，生活会是什么样。

sentences.en: These emotions help make us whole.
sentences.zh: 这些情绪使我们成为完整的人。

sentences.en: They give us a way to understand life in all its beauty and suffering.
sentences.zh: 它们让我们能够理解生活中的所有美好与苦难。

sentences.en: But an emotion like envy is entirely different.
sentences.zh: 但像嫉妒这样的情绪则完全不同。
它让人感到厌恶、毫无用处。

sentences.en: But of course, that's far from the truth.
Envy, in fact, drives us in fascinating ways, sometimes making us better people, sometimes not.
sentences.zh: 事实上，嫉妒以迷人的方式驱动着我们，有时让我们变得更好，有时则不然。

sentences.en: To understand it, we begin where any good conversation on envy should begin,
sentences.zh: 为了理解它，我们从任何关于嫉妒的良好对话都应该开始的地方说起，
这很有趣，因为这是事实。

sentences.en: Homer is an excellent example of pretty much all the seven deadly sins.
sentences.zh: 荷马几乎是七宗罪所有罪行的绝佳代表。

sentences.en: I'm just a big toasty cinnamon bun.
sentences.zh: 我只是个又大又暖和的肉桂卷。

sentences.en: I never want to leave this bed.
sentences.zh: 我永远不想离开这张床。

sentences.en: Homer is also consumed with envy.
sentences.zh: 荷马也深受嫉妒的折磨。

sentences.en: Especially of his do-gooder neighbor, Ned Flanders.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对他那个好好先生邻居内德·弗兰德斯。

sentences.en: You know, if you gave Ned Flanders a chance...
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你给内德·弗兰德斯一个机会……

sentences.en: Look, I don't care if Ned Flanders is the nicest guy in the world.
sentences.zh: 听着，我不在乎内德·弗兰德斯是不是世界上最好的人。
荷马无法忍受弗兰德斯。

sentences.en: Well, Flanders is a pillar of the community.
sentences.zh: 嗯，弗兰德斯是社区的中流砥柱。

sentences.en: Well, we can't hold it against them just because he has things a little better than
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们不能仅仅因为他过得比我们好一点，就对他心怀不满。

sentences.en: You really put me in my place.
sentences.zh: 你真是让我认清了自己的位置。

sentences.en: It's worth feeling three inches tall to find out what kind of a person you really are.
sentences.zh: 为了认清自己到底是什么样的人，哪怕感到自惭形秽也是值得的。

sentences.en: Marge Simpson, president of the international We Love Flanders fan club.
sentences.zh: 玛姬·辛普森，国际“我们爱弗兰德斯”粉丝俱乐部主席。

sentences.en: Usually, Homer is left to stew in his own bitter bile, but one day, Flanders does something
sentences.zh: 通常，荷马只能独自沉浸在苦涩的怨气中，但有一天，弗兰德斯做了一件

sentences.en: He announces he's quitting his job.
As of Friday, I'm saying toodaloo to the pharmaceutical game.
sentences.zh: 从周五开始，我要跟制药行业说再见了。

sentences.en: What are you going to do, Ned?
Well, sir, like one out of every nine Americans, I'm left-handed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，先生，就像九分之一的美国人一样，我是左撇子。

sentences.en: And let me tell you, it ain't all peaches and cream.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，这可不是什么轻松惬意的事。
你的字迹会弄得一团糟。

sentences.en: Lord help you if you want to drive a standard transmission.
sentences.zh: 如果你想开手动挡的车，上帝保佑你吧。

sentences.en: Well, sir, I'm opening up a one-stop store for Southpaws.
sentences.zh: 所以，先生，我打算开一家专门服务左撇子的一站式商店。

sentences.en: Everything from left-handed apple peelers to left-handed zithers.
sentences.zh: 从左撇子削苹果机到左撇子齐特琴，应有尽有。
我打算叫它“左撇子商店”。

sentences.en: A store with gadgets for left-handed people.
sentences.zh: 一家专卖左撇子用品的商店。

sentences.en: Finally, Homer feels he has the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 终于，荷马觉得他占了上风。

sentences.en: The Leftorium, he believes, is a truly stupid idea.
sentences.zh: 他认为，“左撇子商店”真是个愚蠢透顶的主意。

sentences.en: Homer dreams that it will finally lead to Flanders' downfall.
sentences.zh: 荷马梦想着这最终会导致弗兰德斯的垮台。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, Flanders' store was deserted.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，弗兰德斯的店里空无一人。

sentences.en: So what do you think of your bestest buddy now, Marge?
sentences.zh: 那么玛姬，你现在怎么看你最好的哥们儿？

sentences.en: Dad, do you know what schadenfreude is?
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你知道什么是“幸灾乐祸”吗？

sentences.en: No, I do not know what schadenfreude is.
sentences.zh: 不，我不知道什么是“幸灾乐祸”。

sentences.en: Please tell me because I'm dying to know.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我，因为我急于想知道。

sentences.en: It's a German term for shameful joy, taking pleasure in the suffering of others.
sentences.zh: 这是一个德语词，意为可耻的快乐，即从他人的苦难中获得快感。

sentences.en: I'm just glad to see him fall flat on his butt.
sentences.zh: 我只是很高兴看到他摔个底朝天。

sentences.en: He's usually all happy and comfortable and surrounded by loved ones.
sentences.zh: 他平时总是那么快乐、舒适，被爱人包围着。

sentences.en: What's the opposite of that shameful joy thing he hears?
sentences.zh: 那个他听到的可耻快乐的反义词是什么？

sentences.en: Boy, those Germans have a word for everything.
sentences.zh: 天哪，德国人真是万事都有对应的词。

sentences.en: Part of what makes Homer Simpson such an interesting character
sentences.zh: 荷马·辛普森之所以成为如此有趣的角色，部分原因在于

sentences.en: is that he happily and openly expresses thoughts and feelings
sentences.zh: 他快乐而坦率地表达了许多我们内心深处认同的想法和感受，

sentences.en: many of us secretly identify with,
sentences.zh: 包括嫉妒及其讨厌的伙伴——幸灾乐祸。

sentences.en: including Envy and its nasty sidekick, schadenfreude.
sentences.zh: 嫉妒触及了人类行为阴暗的一面。

sentences.en: Envy taps into a dark side of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着它毫无价值。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean it's without value.
sentences.zh: 像所有情绪一样，它有其目的。

sentences.en: Like all emotions, it has a purpose.
sentences.zh: 人类学家克里斯托弗·伯姆曾撰写过大量著作，

sentences.en: The anthropologist Christopher Bohm has written extensively
sentences.zh: 探讨我们祖先中长期存在的等级制度，

sentences.en: on the hierarchies that have long existed among our ancestors,
sentences.zh: 无论是早期的狩猎采集部落还是我们的灵长类亲属。

sentences.en: both early hunter-gatherer tribes and our primate relatives.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗就嫉妒的起源提出了两点看法。

sentences.en: Christopher makes two points about the origins of Envy.

sentences.zh: 在狩猎采集群体中，总有一些更有天赋的人，

sentences.en: In a hunter-gatherer group, there are always more gifted individuals
sentences.zh: 他们在智力、社交或性吸引力等方面更胜一筹。

sentences.en: who are more intelligent, attractive socially or sexually, and so on.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在平等主义社会中，也存在相当多的不平等。

sentences.en: So there are a considerable number of inequalities
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗提出的另一点是，这些差异很重要。
部落成员对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: The other point Christopher makes is that such differences matter.
sentences.zh: 即使是灵长类动物也会关注社会等级。

sentences.en: They're not lost on the members of a tribe.
Even primates pay attention to social ranking.

sentences.zh: 一位名叫钱斯的皮肤科医生研究了狒狒的行为，
他在研究中讨论了注意力的指向。

sentences.en: A dermatologist named Chance on baboon behavior
sentences.zh: 他只是系统地测量了狒狒个体的目光投向。

sentences.en: in which he discussed the direction of attention.
sentences.zh: 他发现，不出所料，阿尔法雄性（首领）

sentences.en: He simply measured individuals' gazes were directed
sentences.zh: 受到的关注远超其他任何个体。
而且不仅仅是阿尔法雄性。

sentences.en: He found that the alpha male, no surprise,
sentences.zh: 每个成员似乎都非常清楚

sentences.en: was gazed at ever so much more than anybody else.
sentences.zh: 自己在部落等级制度中所处的位置。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the alpha male.
sentences.zh: 这种结合，即不平等的现实，

sentences.en: Every member seemed to be intimately aware
sentences.zh: 这种结合，即不平等的现实，

sentences.en: of where he or she stood in the hierarchy of the tribe.
sentences.zh: 这种结合，即不平等的现实，

sentences.en: This combination, the reality of inequalities,
sentences.zh: 这种结合，即不平等的现实，

sentences.en: and the fact that we are hardwired to notice them,
sentences.zh: 而我们天生就会注意到这些事实，

sentences.en: this is the fuel for our endless capacity for envy.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们无尽嫉妒心的燃料。

sentences.en: Meena Chikara, a social psychologist at Harvard,
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的社会心理学家米娜·奇卡拉（Meena Chikara）

sentences.en: says it's exactly the same with humans.
sentences.zh: 表示人类的情况也完全一样。

sentences.en: We make sense of the world through social comparisons.
sentences.zh: 我们通过社会比较来理解这个世界。

sentences.en: When you meet a new person,
sentences.zh: 当你遇到一个新人的时候，

sentences.en: there are a lot of things about them

sentences.zh: 是你立刻就会注意到的，

sentences.en: but you don't just register them
in some abstract or absolute sense.
sentences.zh: 以某种抽象或绝对的意义去注意他们。

sentences.en: You register them relative to yourself.
sentences.zh: 你是相对于你自己来衡量他们的。

sentences.en: So not just how tall is this person,
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是这个人有多高，

sentences.en: but how much taller or shorter are they than I am?
sentences.zh: 而是他们比我高多少或矮多少？

sentences.en: We do this because the comparison tells us
sentences.zh: 我们这样做是因为这种比较告诉我们

sentences.en: what our place is in the human hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我们在人类等级制度中处于什么地位。

sentences.en: What's more, it alerts us to imbalances
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，它提醒我们注意那些
可能需要我们关注的不平衡之处。

sentences.en: I might look at my colleague, Steve Inskey,
sentences.zh: 我可能会看看我的同事史蒂夫·因斯基（Steve Inskey），

sentences.en: and notice he not only hosts
sentences.zh: 并注意到他不仅主持着
一档广受欢迎的公共广播节目。

sentences.en: It's morning edition from NPR News.
sentences.zh: 那是NPR新闻的《早间新闻》（Morning Edition）。

sentences.en: But he also manages to find time
to write a new book nearly every other year.
sentences.zh: 几乎每隔一年就写一本新书。

sentences.en: but in a way sociologists call benign.
sentences.zh: 但这种嫉妒在社会学家看来是良性的。

sentences.en: I don't wish anything bad to happen to him.
sentences.zh: 我并不希望他发生什么坏事。

sentences.en: I just wish that I was more like him.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望自己能更像他一点。

sentences.en: Maybe the feeling might push me to work harder.
sentences.zh: 也许这种感觉会促使我更加努力工作。

sentences.en: So if you have more than what I have,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你拥有的比我多，

sentences.en: I may be inspired by what you have.
sentences.zh: 我可能会被你所拥有的东西所激励。

sentences.en: I may experience these benign forms of envy,
sentences.zh: 我可能会经历这些良性的嫉妒，

sentences.en: which could also manifest as admiration.
I remember this one time in college,
I was going with two girlfriends to go shopping.
sentences.zh: 我和两个女性朋友去逛街。

sentences.en: They were about to buy a new table
sentences.zh: 她们正打算买一张新桌子

sentences.en: This is Leah Murthy from Houston, Texas.
sentences.zh: 这是来自德克萨斯州休斯顿的莉亚·默西（Leah Murthy）。

sentences.en: On that shopping trip with friends,
sentences.zh: 在那次和朋友的购物之旅中，

sentences.en: she found herself suffering from benign envy.
sentences.zh: 她发现自己产生了良性的嫉妒。

sentences.en: One of the friends had just gotten married
to a senior who had graduated.
And he was out somewhere else in the country
sentences.zh: 他当时在全国的其他地方

sentences.en: She checked her bank account before we left
sentences.zh: 我们在出发前她查了银行账户，

sentences.en: And that was a substantial amount of money
sentences.zh: 在大学时代，这对我来说

sentences.en: to me back in college days
where I only had a few hundred dollars
sentences.zh: 因为我当时银行账户里

sentences.en: on a good day in my bank account.
sentences.zh: 运气好的时候也只有几百美元。

sentences.en: Leah was envious of her friend
and the kind of table she could afford.
sentences.zh: 以及她能买得起的那种桌子。

sentences.en: She made it a goal one day
sentences.zh: 她给自己定了一个目标，有一天

sentences.en: to get her own nice table.
sentences.zh: 也要买一张属于自己的好桌子。

sentences.en: My first table that I bought for my apartment
sentences.zh: 我为公寓买的第一张桌子
是在旧货店花15美元买的。

sentences.en: And of course it didn't last,
but years later when we saved
sentences.zh: 但多年后，当我们存了钱

sentences.en: and we finally were able to buy a good table.
sentences.zh: 我们终于能够买到一张好桌子了。

sentences.en: It's been with us for almost 10 years now.
sentences.zh: 它陪伴我们到现在已经快10年了。

sentences.en: And I think learning that patience
when it came to money and time
So Leah's envy motivated her to plan and save
sentences.zh: 所以莉亚的嫉妒激励她去规划、储蓄

sentences.en: and build the kind of life she wanted.
But envy doesn't always work in this happy fashion.
sentences.zh: 但嫉妒并不总是以这种快乐的方式起作用。

sentences.en: In fact, there's evidence that envy makes us unhappy
sentences.zh: 事实上，有证据表明嫉妒会让我们不快乐，
